name: PDF Split
summary: Split a PDF by page range, every page, or fixed chunks — privately in your browser.
description: Upload one PDF, extract pages (e.g. 1-3,5), split every page into its own file, or cut into N-page chunks. Downloads stay on your device via pdf-lib. Encrypted PDFs are not supported.

faqs.question: Is my PDF uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Splitting runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: How do page ranges work?
faqs.answer: Use commas and hyphens, like 1-3,5,8-. Open-ended ranges go through the last page.

faqs.question: Can I split password-protected PDFs?
faqs.answer: Not yet. Encrypted files show a clear unsupported message.
